capabilities: Open Markdown notes in a vertical-writing pane via toolbar button or command
Edit directly in the vertical view with auto-save back to the Markdown file
Insert furigana ruby in seven Kakuyomu, Narou, Aozora, and Denden syntaxes
Keep the editing line centered with typewriter mode
Count characters and displayed columns while writing
extras: README carries repeated beta warnings advising backups and points to a ROADMAP.md for planned updates; bug reports and feature requests go through Issues.
problem: Obsidian's standard editor only lays out text horizontally, so Japanese writers who need vertical writing and furigana ruby have no way to compose in it.
summary: Vertical-writing editor that opens Markdown notes in a vertical-rl pane for composing Japanese novels and screenplays.
